21138.ins: The 115 cm chain is the longest in the collar category - real lead distance rather than the decorative dangle the shorter sets offer - and the collar closes on standard buckle hardware. Three set colorways, printed lengths, nightclub finish under light rigs.
21138.short: Nightclub leather collar with 115 cm adjustable chain in set black, pink or white, collar 46 cm, printed lengths, buckle closure.

21139.ins: The elastic band is the engineering: it holds at the thigh through an evening without pinching, which is the failure mode that ends most garter wear early. Black, pink, or white to match the lingerie set it finishes.
21139.short: Stretch leg garter with love-bow accent in black, pink or white, one-size elastic band, finishing accessory for any lingerie set.

21167.ins: The heart centerpiece against punk hardware is the collision the design lives on - soft symbol, hard setting - and it moves between costume drawers and lingerie drawers without looking wrong in either. Three shades from stark black to warm red.
21167.short: Punk leather collar with heart centerpiece in black, pink or red, one-size buckle closure, bridges costume and lingerie wardrobes.

21168.ins: Openwork - the skeleton cut - makes the heart the focal piece at conversation distance, and the 110 cm chain gives the length option plain collars skip. Collar at 45 cm, chain matched, three colorways with printed measurements.
21168.short: Skeleton-heart leather collar with 110 cm chain in white, black or pink, openwork design, collar 45 cm, printed measurements.

21176.ins: Leather rather than elastic changes the garter's character: it holds its shape instead of stretching into it, which suits outfits where the firm line is the point. Black with the heart accent, 40-50 cm adjustment for thigh placement.
21176.short: Black leather leg garter with heart accent, structured 40-50 cm adjustment band for thigh wear, pairs with the collar line.

21194.ins: Heart-on-black is the format's classic register, and the slip-on construction means no hardware to fiddle with mid-evening - it goes on and stays put. One set, one color, the entry-level pick for a first collar in the drawer.
21194.short: Black love collar set with heart detailing, slip-on one-size fit, pairs with lingerie and bedroom outfits, couples entry pick.

21198.ins: The jingle is the calibration detail - present at movement, absent at rest - and the light build keeps the neck ring wearable through a full evening where heavier pieces start to bother. Black or white to match the headband half of the costume.
21198.short: Cute bow bell neck ring in black or white, lightweight one-size build with soft jingle, finishing piece for cosplay looks.

21199.ins: Two styles - 3039 and 3040 - differ in shape rather than concept, both in sheer lace that obscures without blocking: the design intent, stated plainly. Four combinations of style and color at a price that makes the choice low-stakes.
21199.short: Sheer lace eye patch in styles 3039 and 3040, black or white, gentle fit with soft lace edge, obscures without fully blocking.

21200.ins: The ears hold their shape through wear - the structural test plush headbands usually fail by midnight - and the bell completes the cat read in a single piece. White or black, one size, matched to the cat-bell collar line in the same category.
21200.short: Plush cat-ear headband with bell in white or black, one size, shape-holding construction, pairs with the cat collar line.

21223.ins: Silicone is the material upgrade in the mask format - it flexes, warms to skin, and cleans properly where lace and leather each compromise one of those three. The rose centerpiece runs 4.2 cm on a 60 cm adjustable strap, specs printed on the listing.
21223.short: Silicone rose mask in black or red with 60 cm adjustable strap and 4.2 cm rose centerpiece, flexible printed-spec construction.
